_comment: Published release history, newest last. build.sh appends the version it is
building to this and writes the whole list into manifest.json, so Jellyfin
offers every release and not only the newest one.
Entries here are already published: their zips live on their own tag's
release and cannot be rebuilt byte-for-byte, so the checksums are recorded
rather than recomputed. Add the version being released to this file as part
of the release commit, then tag.

6f1c9d24-3b7a-4f18-9d55-2e7a1c4b8e90.changelog: 12.0.0.0 for Jellyfin 12. Listed under Books and as a selectable book metadata provider. Settings page no longer overlays other dashboard pages. Server URL starts blank.

8c3e5a17-42b9-4d6e-b1f0-9a7c5d2e4b83.changelog: 12.0.0.0 for Jellyfin 12. Listed under Books and as a selectable book metadata provider. Settings page no longer overlays other dashboard pages. Reads titles, publication dates, and tags per the MangaBaka spec. Optional beta (v2) API.
